resources.string: Shows available scene thumbnails above the timeline. Requires your own Seekr key.
Get your key at seekr.tv, then enter it here. The key is stored encrypted on this TV.

Create your account at https://seekr.tv, verify your email and claim a key. Availability and service limits depend on Seekr. Only the title ID, episode and duration are sent; the video link stays on the TV. Missing previews never block playback.
